title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Historical Toe Pad Samples from Birds
author: Dave Lutgen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bm4mk8u6
materials: Buffer ATL (tissue lysis buffer) Qiagen Catalog #19076
QiAmp DNA Micro kit Qiagen Catalog #56304
To make sure no tissue is left on the blade, pipet 80 µL of Buffer ATL Qiagen Catalog #19076 over the scalpel blade, then remove it and ensure all tissue remains in the digestion.

Pipet 100 µL of Buffer ATL (tissue lysis buffer) Qiagen Catalog #19076 over the micropestle to ensure all tissue remains in the digestion. Transfer the pestle into the prepared 1.5 mL Safe Lock Tube Eppendorf Catalog #0030120086 for storage.

After 06:00:00 , centrifuge the tubes and add 20 µL of Proteinase K, 2mL Qiagen Catalog #19131 to the remaining tissue. Use the pestle to further crush tissue parts. Pipet a second volume of 180 µL Buffer ATL (tissue lysis buffer) Qiagen Catalog #19076 over the pestle to ensure all tissue remains in the digestion.
Preheat AL lysis buffer Qiagen Catalog #19075 at 56 °C . This step prevents the formation of precipitates when AL lysis buffer Qiagen Catalog #19075 is added to the digestion.

This protocol uses the QiAmp DNA Micro kit Qiagen Catalog #56304 with 2x the amount/volumes of Proteinase K, 2mL Qiagen Catalog #19131 Buffer ATL (tissue lysis buffer) Qiagen Catalog #19076 AL lysis buffer Qiagen Catalog #19075 RNase A Qiagen Catalog #19101 .
Put the column into the thermoshaker 0 rpm, 37 °C, 7 minutes Then spin at 8000 rpm, °C, 2 minutes .
If you expect high(er) amounts of DNA, repeat steps go to step #25 and go to step #26 with another 20 µL of 1:1 diluted AE buffer Qiagen Catalog #19077 .

steps.title: Rinse tissue to remove chemicals
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL ultrapure distilled, nuclease‑free water to the toe pad, incubate at 1000 rpm, 56 °C for 1 h, discard all water and ensure no residual water remains.

steps.title: Transfer tissue to tube
steps.instruction: Place 2–3 mg toe pad or breast skin tissue into a 1.5 mL Safe‑Lock tube (Eppendorf #0030120086) using a scalpel tip.

steps.title: Mince tissue
steps.instruction: Mince the tissue with a pointed scalpel blade; use a new blade for each sample.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and buffer, crush
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K and 2 mL Qiagen buffer #19131 to the tube, crush the tissue with a micropestle (keep pestle in tube).

steps.title: Vortex and incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube, then incubate at 900 rpm, 56 °C for 6 h; set the timer to infinity.

steps.title: Prepare 1:1 AE dilution
steps.instruction: Mix equal volumes of ultrapure nuclease‑free water and AE buffer (Qiagen #19077) to make a 1:1 dilution, then preheat to 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare tubes, pestle, and AL buffer
steps.instruction: Label a 1.5 mL Safe‑Lock tube for each extraction (two tubes for two elutions); prepare one Micropestle (Merck #BAF199230001) per sample and store it in a separate 1.5 mL Safe‑Lock tube; preheat AL lysis buffer (Qiagen #19075) to 56 °C.

steps.title: Clarify lysate if undigested material
steps.instruction: If undigested fragments remain, centrifuge the lysate at maximum speed for 5 min, then transfer the supernatant to a new tube; otherwise proceed.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase A (Qiagen #19101), vortex, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Add AL buffer and dissolve coagulate
steps.instruction: Vortex for 15 s, add 400 µL preheated 56 °C AL lysis buffer (Qiagen #19075), mix quickly (a coagulate forms), then dissolve by incubating at 900 rpm, 56 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add cold ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ice‑cold (‑20 °C) absolute ethanol (99.8 %, catalog #10342652), vortex thoroughly, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column (first portion)
steps.instruction: Apply 650 µL of lysate to the spin column, centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 min, discard flow‑through, dry the collection tube, and return the column to the tube.

steps.title: Load remaining lysate
steps.instruction: Apply the remaining lysate to the column, centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 min, discard flow‑through, and discard the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1 (Qiagen #19081), centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 min, discard flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2 (Qiagen #19072), centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 min, discard flow‑through, dry the collection tube, and return the column to it.

steps.title: Dry membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14000 rpm for 2 min to dry the membrane, ensure no ethanol remains, and discard the collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the column into a labeled 1.5 mL Safe‑Lock tube, add 20 µL preheated (37 °C) 1:1 diluted AE buffer (Qiagen #19077) to the column.

steps.title: Preheat AE buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Set the heat block to 37 °C, preheat the 1:1 diluted AE buffer to 37 °C, and vortex the column well.

steps.title: Extended overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Continue incubation at 900 rpm, 56 °C for 1 day 16 h (optional to increase DNA yield); ensure all tissue pieces remain in solution.
